name: Tessaway Freight golden set
about: The same 24 Part 1 questions, with the correct answers under revenue version 2 and margin version 2 (data/DEFINITIONS.md), frozen before any Part 7 agent run. Six answers differ from version 1 (M2, M3, M4, E1, E3, R3 were recomputed; E1's name is unchanged); the other 18 are version 1's answers. Version 1 stays as it was. Tessaway Freight is a fictional company and the owner is a fictional role.

change_log.change: Revenue moves from the invoice date to the delivery date, and carrier cost moves with it (revenue version 2, margin version 2). Gold SQL reviewed against data/DEFINITIONS.md and run once on the warehouse of record; answers pinned by hash.
